tagline: Lakewatch is now available in Beta.
what_it_does: Lakewatch is now available in Beta. Use Lakewatch to ingest security logs into governed tables, run detection rules, and investigate and respond to alerts on Databricks. Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the Previews page.
